title: Bonespike Boots

sources.title: Evasive Instinct
markers: | description = You have a +1 bonus to {{ArmourClass}} and {{Saving Throw}}s as long as you are not wearing [[armour]] or holding a [[Shields|shield]].

sources.title: Brutal Leap
markers: | description = Leap at a target and possibly knock it {{cond|Prone}}.

summary: Without armour or a shield, gain +1 AC and saves. Jump 5 ft farther. Brutal Leap costs a Bonus Action and 10 ft movement once per turn, reaches about 35 ft with these boots, and enemies within 10 ft of landing make a Strength save against your spell save DC or fall Prone for 2 turns.
